messages:
Noah Brooks: Quick sync 3 Prospect (large payments) sent a vendor risk review. Their top asks: exact breach notification timeline, CAIQ evidence, RCA timing, and whether Redwood will notify regulators on their behalf. They're demanding an unconditional 72-hour contractual clause.

Aisha Khan: Short: we cant give an unconditional 72h from detection. We can offer an operational target of initial notification within 72 hours of confirmation of an incident where reasonably practicable, with law-enforcement/forensics carve-outs.

Victor Nguyen: Suggested contract wording to propose: "Upon confirmation of a Security Incident materially affecting Customer Data, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide Customer with an initial notification describing the nature and known impact of the incident within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation where reasonably practicable. Notification timing may be adjusted to preserve forensic integrity or comply with law enforcement directives; Redwood will notify Customer if such constraints apply."

Contracts Bot: Add to clause: initial notification will include severity, affected systems, preliminary impact, mitigation steps, and a named point of contact. Also call out that detailed RCA timelines are estimates.

Noah Brooks: They also want proof: completed CAIQ/SIG, SOC2 report, runbooks, and drill cadence. What can we share under NDA?

IR Ops: We can provide a redacted CAIQ snapshot and SOC 2 summary under NDA and a redacted IR runbook excerpt. Tabletop cadence: annual company-wide + quarterly service drills for Dedicated customers.

Aisha Khan: Runbook excerpt (redacted):

```
Detect & Triage (0-4h): validate alert, classify severity, scope estimate
Containment (4-24h): isolate affected services, temporary mitigations
Initial Notification (24-72h): prepare notice, legal review, notify impacted customers
Remediation (72h+): deploy fixes, validate, begin RCA
Post-incident (30-90d): draft/final RCA, mitigations, follow-ups
```

Victor Nguyen: RCA cadence we typically share: preliminary findings ~7-14 business days, draft RCA ~30 days, final RCA 30-90 days depending on complexity and third-party forensics. Mention that POC/trial orgs have limited operational guarantees.

Noah Brooks: Channels for notification?

IR Ops: Primary = customer-designated security contact (email + phone) and account team. For Dedicated/Private customers we also publish advisories to the customer portal. We do not independently file regulator notices on behalf of customers unless contractually authorized; we will provide artifacts and reasonable assistance for customer filings.

Security Bot: Recommend adding a transparency cadence: for Sev1 incidents provide status updates at least every 24 hours until containment; include a named on-call POC for Enterprise/Dedicated customers. Offerable SLA: Sev1 1-hour acknowledgement for Dedicated customers.

Noah Brooks: Customer asked for a single-sentence confirmation to accept into their legal team. Suggested one-liner: "Redwood will notify Customer without undue delay and, when reasonably practicable, within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation of a Security Incident materially affecting Customer Data; notification timing may be adjusted to preserve forensic integrity or comply with law enforcement directives."

Aisha Khan: I'll attach CAIQ samples (redacted) and the runbook excerpt, plus the proposed clause and the SLA options. Also call out that public incident history is only published for platform-wide incidents on status.redwood.com; otherwise we share customer-specific post-incident reports on a need-to-know basis.

Victor Nguyen: I'll review the email for operational accuracy in 20 mins. Contracts Bot: please sanity-check the clause.

Contracts Bot: Template links: https://internal.redwood/contracts/ir-clauses and CAIQ under NDA: https://internal.redwood/security/ca iq-samples (access: legal-sales, security).

Noah Brooks: Thanks team 44D I'll send the draft after reviews.
